parameters.formDescription: Start a new short-film project: your title, your story, and character reference images.

parameters.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, datetime, json, os
payload = json.loads(base64.b64decode("{{ $json.payloadB64 }}").decode("utf-8"))
slug = payload["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
for sub in ["", "refs", "refs/original", "shots", "audio", "audio/lines", "render", "music", "logs"]:
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, sub) if sub else root, exist_ok=True)
for i, ref in enumerate(payload["refs"], 1):
    p = os.path.join(root, "refs", "original", "ref_%02d.%s" % (i, ref["ext"]))
    with open(p, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(base64.b64decode(ref["b64"]))
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
proj = {"slug": slug, "title": payload["title"], "story": payload["story"],
        "created_at": now, "updated_at": now, "status": "created", "stages": {},
        "counts": {"refs": len(payload["refs"])}, "notes": ""}
with open(os.path.join(root, "project.json"), "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "root": root, "refs": len(payload["refs"])}))
PY

cd "/home/node/files/films/{{ $('Normalize Input').first().json.slug }}/refs" || exit 1
i=1
for f in original/*; do
  ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i "$f" -vf "scale='min(1024,iw)':-2" -q:v 4 "ref_$(printf '%02d' $i).jpg" || echo "normalize failed: $f"
  i=$((i+1))
done
ls -la . | tail -n +2
